passages.original: Anonymus Interpres ab Origene citatus ἔλεγε δή τις τῶν πρὸ ἡμῶν 119,17.
passages.english: An anonymous interpreter quoted by Origen: "Now one of those before us said" 119,17.
passages.notes: The passage is mostly an editorial heading in Latin ("Anonymus Interpres ab Origene citatus", "An anonymous interpreter quoted by Origen"), followed by the opening words of a Greek quotation (ἔλεγε δή τις τῶν πρὸ ἡμῶν, "now one of those before us said"). The quotation itself is cut off. "119,17" appears to be a page-and-line reference to the printed edition.
